title: Kit smoke test
lede: Twenty seconds that touch every helper in the kit: the sheet, a dimension line, the sealed commit, a question card, a count of marks, a caption and the CETI brand card.

commit.title: YOUR GUESS
commit.prompt: How many of 100 marks are red?

captions: The plan says twelve months. Everyone signed it.
Before the count: how many of a hundred marks are red?
Count them one by one. Thirty of a hundred are red.

brand.takeaway: Count the marks before you trust the ratio.

sources: Synthetic smoke fixture: 100 marks, 30 red (this folder's claims.json).
